7_clad_benchmark_F-050.interpretation: AT SCALE THE TOKEN OPTIMIZER WORKS AS DESIGNED. Pruning F-050 + its (transitive) deps from a 100-feature catalog cuts the LLM payload from 13,521 to 237 tokens — a 98.2% reduction. This is the empirical answer to the simple-cell finding of negative reduction.

notes: **THE HEADLINE NUMBER**: 98.2% token reduction on a 100-feature spec validates the Token Optimizer's design intent.
cladding's sharded layout has the SAME total raw size as harness monolith but radically different access cost: 540 chars / feature vs 15,324 tokens to load all 100.
clad sync on 100 features completes in ~ 25 ms; load time is acceptable up to the size we tested.
